note: Outside proof for 'Is this gap real?' and step 5 of the Run: published before-and-after figures next to the model's effect size. Every quote is word for word from the source.
backtest_en: No backtest is possible: Finland has published each county's share only for two overlapping pooled periods (2018 to mid-2022 and 2019–2023), so there is no earlier period to fit on.

items.introduced_en: Guideline-based work-up before surgery: a stair-climbing fitness test, PET-CT, more high-risk patients operated
items.what_en: Share of all lung cancer patients operated
items.quote: The overall resection rate increased from 10.5%-19.7 %, mainly due to a higher number of high-risk patients (12.7 % vs. 34.3 %, p < 0.001).
items.source_title: Helminen et al., Lung Cancer 2020, 2,116 patients
items.caveat_en: Two hospital districts, no control area, surgery only, and several changes at once. The abstract does not give the year the two periods split.

items.introduced_en: A weekly review of every patient's pathway, with a check that each one reached the team meeting (started 2020/2021)
items.what_en: Share of all lung cancer patients treated to cure
items.quote: Lungeseksjonen på Elverum Sykehus har opprettet et ukesprogram hvor alle pakkeforløp diskuteres. … Det undersøkes også om pasienten er vudert til MDT-møte. … I 2022 hadde Sykehuset Innlandet HF 39 % kurativt behandlede pasienter og Sykehuset i Telemark hadde 35 %. Det er en forbedring fra henholdsvis 33 og 30 % i 2018.
items.source_title: Cancer Registry of Norway, lung cancer quality register, annual report 2023, Table 5.1
items.caveat_en: One trust of about 250 patients a year, no control area. The same report's 2023 row sums to about 34%, so part of the rise did not hold.

items.what_en: Stereotactic radiotherapy within a year of diagnosis
items.source_title: Finnish Cancer Registry, lung cancer report, Table 7
items.caveat_en: A national trend, not a trial of the referral rule: it shows the share moves by this much in four years. Surgery stayed at 16.5%.
items.introduced_en: Stereotactic radiotherapy spreading across the country

summary_en: Three measured changes of the same kind, each larger than what the plan assumes. None is a trial of the plan's own actions.
